(2) He looks directly at the camera while continuing to hold the book, his expression is calm and earnest. He starts to gesture with his left hand as he speaks, maintaining the medium shot composition against the light-colored wall. (3) Large, semi-transparent Chinese characters appear as an overlay across his face and body as he emphasizes specific points from the book. He briefly adjusts the book in his hands, showcasing the cover more clearly to the viewer. (4) He reaches for another version of the book, holding two different cover designs side-by-side to show the options. He uses his fingers to point out specific design details on the covers, such as the title and artwork. (5) He introduces a smaller booklet, flipping through the pages to reveal internal content like photographs and handwritten-style text. His movements are deliberate and slow to ensure the camera captures the details of the pages. (6) He holds up a card with various small icons and text, gesturing towards it with his right hand. He maintains eye contact with the lens, smiling occasionally to create a friendly atmosphere. (7) Finally, he gathers all the books and the booklet in his hands, holding them close to his chest while a large yellow text overlay appears with pre-order information including a date and time.
